title: Celestial Eye Serenade
description: A surreal night scene features a giant stylized human eye at the bottom with a blue iris containing a piano and floating musical notes. Above a dark hill, a woman in a flowing robe stands holding a glowing lantern while musical notes float around her. Two large grinning celestial cats with multiple eyes emerge from swirling clouds near a crescent moon, surrounded by hanging orange lanterns.
prompt: Surreal fantasy night scene with a massive stylized eye at the bottom of the frame, its blue iris containing a grand piano and glowing orb. A woman in a long robe stands on a hill holding a lantern as musical notes swirl around her. Two giant grinning black cats with three eyes each float in the starry sky near a crescent moon, surrounded by hanging orange lanterns and ethereal smoke.
